Below is the table layout including the original columns of date, sales, prev_sales, diff, as well as the newly added margin column, which is calculated as 30% of the sales values. The margin values are rounded for clarity.

| Date       | Sales   | Prev Sales | Diff    | Margin   |
|------------|---------|------------|---------|----------|
| 01/02/2013 | 459,417 | 454,904    | 4,513   | 137,825  |
| 01/03/2013 | 617,382 | 459,417    | 157,965 | 185,215  |
| 01/04/2013 | 682,274 | 617,382    | 64,892  | 204,682  |
| 01/05/2013 | 763,242 | 682,274    | 80,968  | 228,973  |
| 01/06/2013 | 795,597 | 763,242    | 32,355  | 238,679  |
| 01/07/2013 | 855,922 | 795,597    | 60,325  | 256,777  |
| 01/08/2013 | 766,761 | 855,922    | -89,161 | 230,028  |
| 01/09/2013 | 689,907 | 766,761    | -76,854 | 206,972  |
| 01/10/2013 | 656,587 | 689,907    | -33,320 | 196,976  |
| 01/11/2013 | 692,643 | 656,587    | 36,056  | 207,793  |

The Margin column has been added to show the calculated value of 30% of each month's Sales total. This additional financial metric can help understand profitability aspects across different months within the dataset.
